card.name: Range dashes between page or number spans
card.fires_on: The dash, the word "to", or the first digit of the second number in a numeric range. It fires in page ranges of citations and in tables of number bands, right after the starting number.

modes.label: Page ranges in citations
modes.description: The dash or first digits of the end page right after the start page in a reference.

modes.label: Dash in number bands
modes.description: A dash between the lower and upper bounds in a table of numeric ranges.

modes.label: Year range with to
modes.description: The word "to" joining two years in running text.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a range of numbers, such as pages or years, switches from its start to its end.
